title: What eVTOL Air Taxi Grids 2.0 Is
definition: eVTOL Air Taxi Grids 2.0: next-gen electric air-taxi grids.

The Signature grid hulls program starts where public roadmaps stop. title: The Signature Vision: eVTOL Air Taxi Grids 2.0
definition: The JAH-original Signature vision of eVTOL Air Taxi Grids 2.0.
description:
The Signature vision of eVTOL Air Taxi Grids 2.0 does not ask what committees will fund — it asks what physics allows and what engineering can compound.

Signature grid hulls program, charter one: master eVTOL fleets at laboratory scale within the decade. Charter two: scale grid logistics manufacturing until cost collapses. Charter three: operate vertiport nets systems continuously, learning in public, improving every cycle.

This is a Signature concept — original JAH speculation, fully specified and honestly labeled. The public edition of this database carries the documented research record; this edition carries the bolder integrated vision: what eVTOL Air Taxi Grids 2.0 becomes when every piece is designed to work with every other piece from day one.

t: Readiness Estimator: eVTOL Air Taxi Grids 2.0
title: Readiness Estimator: eVTOL Air Taxi Grids 2.0
definition: Estimates eVTOL Air Taxi Grids 2.0 readiness from component maturity.
description:
The estimator scores the six eVTOL Air Taxi Grids 2.0 components on the TRL 1–9 scale and averages them into a verdict: research phase, pilot phase, or deployment phase. Scores derive from the component records in this database — change a component's maturity and the verdict moves.

Honest scoring is the point: a grid hulls that averages TRL 3 is not failing, it is three phases from deployment, and the estimator tells you which component drags the average down. Fund that one first.

t: eVTOL Air Taxi Grids 2.0 Systems Simulator
title: eVTOL Air Taxi Grids 2.0 Systems Simulator
definition: Simulates eVTOL Air Taxi Grids 2.0 operating for a day.
description:
The simulator walks a eVTOL Air Taxi Grids 2.0 installation through six operating steps, with seeded randomness standing in for real-world variation. Seed 60843 reproduces this exact run — change the seed in the program to explore other days.

Watch for DEGRADED steps: they mark where eVTOL fleets monitoring, grid logistics redundancy, or vertiport nets maintenance would intervene in a real deployment. A simulator that never degrades is lying; this one degrades about eight percent of the time, like early hardware does.

definition: The united roadmap for eVTOL Air Taxi Grids 2.0: prove, build, operate, compound.
description:
The master roadmap for eVTOL Air Taxi Grids 2.0 — next-gen electric air-taxi grids.

Phase 1 — Prove (eVTOL fleets): laboratory demonstrations of every component, replicated independently. No scaling until the physics is boring.

Phase 2 — Build (grid logistics): pilot manufacturing and integration. The six pieces meet for the first time and the interfaces get honest.

Phase 3 — Operate (vertiport nets): continuous real-world operation. Uptime, cost curves and failure data replace projections.

Phase 4 — Compound (UTM integration): grid hulls as everyday infrastructure. Costs collapse, standards settle, and cities-scale deployment begins.

Signature edition: phases overlap aggressively — integration starts on day one. This record unites the database: overview, research, components, milestones, demos and drills all point here.
key_points: Four phases: Prove, Build, Operate, Compound.
